#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys

import base64

import time
import calendar


def ctime_str(epoch_seconds):
    """Format date as RFC 2822 date string from epoch seconds."""
    t = time.gmtime(epoch_seconds)
    wday = calendar.day_name[t.tm_wday]  # weekday 0=Mon
    mon = calendar.month_name[t.tm_mon]
    return f"{wday}, {t.tm_mday:02d} {mon} {t.tm_year} " \
           f"{t.tm_hour:02d}:{t.tm_min:02d}:{t.tm_sec:02d} +0000"


def rfc2047_encode(s):
    """RFC 2047 encode a string for use in headers."""
    result = []
    words = s.split(' ')
    for i, word in enumerate(words):
        if i > 0:
            result.append(' ')
        if any(ord(c) > 127 for c in word):
            encoded = base64.b64encode(word.encode('utf-8')).decode('ascii')
            result.append(f'=?utf-8?B?{encoded}?=')
        else:
            result.append(word)
    return ''.join(result)


def rfc2231_encode(filename):
    """RFC 2231 encode a filename for Content-Disposition."""
    if all(ord(c) < 128 for c in filename):
        return filename
    encoded = base64.b64encode(filename.encode('utf-8')).decode('ascii')
    return f"*=UTF-8''{encoded}"
